description: Source file implementing the SimpleIndex class for disk cache management, including cache entry metadata, eviction, and disk I/O operations.

classes.name: EntryMetadata
classes.description: Holds metadata for cache entries, including last used time, size, trailer prefetch size, and in-memory data flag.

classes.name: SimpleIndex
classes.description: Manages cache index entries, handles eviction, disk I/O, and provides access to cache entries.

methods.name: EntryMetadata::GetLastUsedTime
methods.description: Returns the last time the cache entry was used.

methods.name: EntryMetadata::SetLastUsedTime
methods.description: Sets the last used time for the cache entry.

methods.name: EntryMetadata::GetTrailerPrefetchSize
methods.description: Returns the trailer prefetch size.

methods.name: EntryMetadata::SetTrailerPrefetchSize
methods.description: Sets the trailer prefetch size.

methods.name: EntryMetadata::GetEntrySize
methods.description: Returns the size of the cache entry.

methods.name: EntryMetadata::SetEntrySize
methods.description: Sets the size of the cache entry.

methods.name: EntryMetadata::Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the entry metadata into a pickle for disk storage.

methods.name: EntryMetadata::Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes entry metadata from a pickle.

methods.name: SimpleIndex::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the index, loading existing entries from disk.

methods.name: SimpleIndex::SetMaxSize
methods.description: Sets the maximum cache size and computes watermarks for eviction.

methods.name: SimpleIndex::ExecuteWhenReady

methods.name: SimpleIndex::GetEntryCount

methods.name: SimpleIndex::GetCacheSize
methods.description: Returns total cache size.

methods.name: SimpleIndex::GetCacheSizeBetween
methods.description: Returns total size of entries within a time range.

methods.name: SimpleIndex::SetLastUsedTimeForTest
methods.description: Sets last used time for testing purposes.

methods.description: Inserts a new entry hash into the index.

methods.description: Removes an entry hash from the index.
